title: Understanding the Logistic Regression Model
text: The logistic regression model predicts the probability that a student prefers Kendrick $$(y=1)$$ or Drake $$(y=0)$$ using the formula: $$P(y=1|X)=\frac{1}{1+e^{-\left(\theta_0+\theta_1 X_1+\theta_2 X_2\right)}}$$.

title: Calculate the Linear Combination
text: Substitute the given values into the linear combination: $$\theta_0+\theta_1 X_1+\theta_2 X_2$$. Use $$theta=(-2, 2, 1)$$, $$X_1=1$$, and $$X_2=0$$.

title: Compute the Linear Combination
text: Calculate the linear combination using the formula: $$-2+2\times1+1\times0$$.

title: Calculate the Probability
text: Use the logistic function to calculate the probability: $$P(y=1|X)=\frac{1}{1+e^{-0}}$$.

title: Compute the Probability
text: Calculate the probability using the formula: $$\frac{1}{1+e^0}$$.

title: Compare with the Threshold
text: Compare the calculated probability with the threshold of $$0.3$$ to determine the classification.

title: Determine the Classification
text: Since $$0.5$$ is greater than $$0.3$$, the student is classified as preferring Kendrick.
